description: Every path an install target plans, with the tool surface it serves and the source that says the tool reads it. tests/ci/tool-paths-contract.test.js plans every adapter in every variant and fails when a planned path is outside this table or a row matches nothing; docs/spec/tool-paths.md is generated from it.

variants.description: Linux or macOS, no override variable set
Windows, where Devin keeps its user config under %APPDATA%
XDG_CONFIG_HOME set to an absolute directory, which moves the Crush config directory (a relative value is ignored and Crush stays in ~/.config/crush)
CRUSH_GLOBAL_CONFIG set, which names the Crush config directory directly (resolved to an absolute path)
KIMI_CODE_HOME set, which moves the Kimi Code data root
TRAE_ENV=cn, the Chinese edition of Trae
